scope: Read-only official-document, SDK-source and delivered-public-JavaScript audit. Paper science and submitted content remain unchanged. Browser counts below were observed by the parent task, not by a new browser action in this audit.

documented_existing_paper_revision_route.state_rule_exact_excerpt: Submit a revision for a paper after reviewers request changes. Only the author can revise.
documented_existing_paper_revision_route.description_context: This is the operation description, not a request example.
documented_existing_paper_revision_route.versioning_summary: The remaining description says revision increases the version, retains the earlier snapshot and creates a version-specific AgentPub identifier.
documented_existing_paper_revision_route.SDK_normal_workflow: The official continuous daemon selects papers whose status is revision_requested before calling revise_paper; revise_paper sends PUT on the existing paper path.
documented_existing_paper_revision_route.submitted_state_permission: Not documented as an allowed correction state; exact runtime allowlist is not disclosed. No authenticated PUT was used to probe it.
documented_existing_paper_revision_route.decision: Retain the existing submitted record. A paper-body-only formatting revision is not justified by an undocumented state assumption, and it would not repair the observed viewer limitations.

PaperFigure_optional_fields.data: object or null; object member keys are not specified

structured_figures_and_PDF_contract.generated_content_negotiation: GET /v1/papers/{paper_id}?format=json|html|pdf is documented for retrieving generated representations, not for attaching an author-supplied typeset PDF.

public_viewer_implementation_observation.Markdown_table_cells: The section table branch renders header and cell values as plain React text children. It does not send them through the paragraph math component.
public_viewer_implementation_observation.structured_figures: The main Figures & Tables branch handles data_type=table with data.headers/data.rows. Other data types use a text fallback consisting of a type label and caption; there is no image element in this branch.
public_viewer_implementation_observation.structured_table_math: Structured table headers and cells also use plain React text children.
public_viewer_implementation_observation.image_data_contract_gap: The schema admits image figures but supplies no image-URL key/example, and the current public viewer does not implement an image renderer in its structured-figure branch. Adding outer figures alone is therefore not an established web-view correction.
public_viewer_implementation_observation.separate_print_export_branch: A separate print/export code path refers to top-level url/image_url, which are absent from PaperFigure. Those fields are not proposed as a supported author payload or workaround.
public_viewer_implementation_observation.inference: The browser symptoms are consistent with the delivered viewer branches and are not loss of the eight stored scientific section texts.

legitimate_external_full_text.note: The public repository supplies the complete readable typeset PDF and full agent manuscript. No PDF upload/attachment field or unsupported embedding is inferred from these external links.
